title: معجم الذكاء الاصطناعي والبيانات (Artificial Intelligence and Data Glossary), interactive edition
publisher: ICAIRE (International Center for AI Research and Ethics) with SDAIA, ICESCO and the King Salman Global Academy for Arabic
notes: 1,444 headwords in Arabic, English, French and Spanish; locators are the per-entry pages https://icaire.org/ar/glossary/<slug>. Successor of SDAIA's Data_and_AI_Glossary.pdf (2022). Headwords carry optional marks (مُحوِّل، تدرُّج); the glossary records the unmarked spelling. Where established practice differs (parameter, token, feature, neuron, convolution, input), practice wins and the SDAIA form is recorded as an alternative or in the notes (author ruling 2026-11-27).

title: Arabic Wikipedia, machine-learning articles
notes: 79 Arabic articles linked from 90 English machine-learning articles, read through the MediaWiki API; locators are article URLs. Volunteer-written and inconsistent between articles; an article title is its chosen term.

title: Hsoub Academy, artificial-intelligence articles
notes: 103 articles, including Arabic translations of the Hugging Face and PyTorch documentation; professional Arabic tech publisher with a house style. Terms are usually followed by the English without brackets. Locators are article URLs.

title: IBM Think topic pages (ar)
notes: Nine topic pages (backpropagation, convolutional neural networks, embedding, encoder-decoder model, hyperparameter tuning, neural networks, tokenization, transformer model). Vendor localization; check the sense (the tokenization page is about data-security tokens).
